sourceText:
Forgotten Cookies
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:01pm

Ingredients




2 egg whites
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
3/4 cup naturally milled sugar
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
1/4 cup chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Beat egg whites, salt, and vanilla with electric mixer until stiff. Add sugar gradually, beating until peaks form. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop teaspoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet. Place in oven, and turn oven off. Leave cookies in oven 4 hours, or overnight.

About


These cookies are gluten-free and delicious- just place 'em in the oven and forget about 'em! From the September/October edition of Optimum Wellness.
